name: bugreport
description: File a structured bug report that lands on the Kanban board as a prioritised backlog card. Collects title, description, steps to reproduce, expected/actual behaviour, severity and environment into a formatted body, prefixes the title with [BUG], maps severity to board priority, and calls kanban_add. Use this instead of kanban_add when the work item is a bug: the template keeps reports consistent and searchable.

title.description: Short summary of the bug (max 500 chars, [BUG] prefix added automatically)

description.description: Detailed explanation of what is wrong

steps_to_reproduce.description: Numbered steps to trigger the bug, e.g. '1. Open config\n2. Set X=Y\n3. Run build'

component.description: Which subsystem or file is affected, e.g. 'src/sandbox/' or 'board'

environment.description: OS, Zig version, config, or anything else that matters for reproducing

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
